line: I'm whole but I'm not pretty. Someone's going to have to scrape me clean. Who do we know with a soft touch?
I'm leaking in three places and it's not the kind of thing that can wait. They'll have to get their hands in me, again.
I've got a dent in my flank. Who do we know with a hammer and a sense of justice?
The hull's got a few dents and a bend in the starboard side. Someone's going to have to straighten me out before I'm back in the yard.
I’ve got a dent in my flank from the last pass. Someone’s going to have to reach in there. I hope they’re gentle.
They peeled back a section of my plating. I've got a lot of exposed metal. Who do we know with steady hands?
There's a dent along my side and someone's going to be explaining it to me in a few hours.
I'm flyable. You'll still need to scrape that burn out of my aft struts. Not that I mind the attention.
There's a dent in my stern and someone's going to have to explain why it's there.
Captain. My plating's got teeth marks and I'm going to need someone with patience to smooth this out.
My port strut's still warm. You didn't need to wait for me, but I appreciated the delay.
A dent's forming on my flank, slow and deliberate. Someone's got a hammer and a grudge — I hope they're good at apologizing.
They'll need to strip back the plating. It's not pretty under there. You'd think I'd be more embarrassed.
There's a dent in my prow and I've got a crew waiting to smooth it out. They don't need to know how much I mind.
No one's chasing. My struts took the brunt. You'll find me unflattering when I'm bent like this.
Quiet now. I've got a few loose panels waiting for fingers. Who do we know with steady hands?
Docking arms are coming. I've got scars where they'll grip. You'll see them when the paint's off.
I've got a dent along the starboard hull. Who do we know with a fondness for heavy tools?
They left me open in three places. Someone's going to have to patch me up. Not that I mind the attention.
They broke off. You'll want to see the damage. It's not the dent. It's not the dent.
